questions.question: A Rs.36,000 annual bonus is distributed among Sales, Marketing, and Operations in a 4:5:3 ratio. Marketing uses Rs.3,000 for team building and Rs.1,500 for an intern, then allocates the rest to two top performers in a 5:4 ratio. How much does the top performer with the smaller share receive?
questions.questionHtml: A Rs.36,000 annual bonus is distributed among Sales, Marketing, and Operations in a 4:5:3 ratio. Marketing uses Rs.3,000 for team building and Rs.1,500 for an intern, then allocates the rest to two top performers in a 5:4 ratio. How much does the top performer with the smaller share receive?
questions.solution:
• Total bonus = Rs.36,000; Ratio = 4:5:3; Total parts = 12

• Marketing share = (5/12) × 36,000 = Rs.15,000

• Deductions: Team building = Rs.3,000; Intern = Rs.1,500; Total = Rs.4,500

• Remaining for top performers = 15,000 - 4,500 = Rs.10,500

• Split in 5:4 ratio → Total parts = 9

• Smaller share (4 parts) = (4/9) × 10,500 = Rs.4,666.67

• Answer: Rs.4,666.67

questions.question: Kapil invested Rs.1,00,000 in a business. After 3 months, Manish joined with Rs.80,000. After 3 more months, Kapil withdrew Rs.40,000. Find their profit ratio at the end of the year.
questions.questionHtml: Kapil invested Rs.1,00,000 in a business. After 3 months, Manish joined with Rs.80,000. After 3 more months, Kapil withdrew Rs.40,000. Find their profit ratio at the end of the year.
questions.solution:
• Total year = 12 months

• Kapil: Rs.1,00,000 for months 1–6 (6 months), then Rs.60,000 for months 7–12 (6 months)

• Kapil's weighted capital = (1,00,000 × 6) + (60,000 × 6) = 6,00,000 + 3,60,000 = 9,60,000

• Manish joined at month 4, so he invests for months 4–12 = 9 months

• Manish's weighted capital = 80,000 × 9 = 7,20,000

• Profit ratio = 9,60,000 : 7,20,000 = 960 : 720 = 4 : 3

• Answer: 4:3

questions.question: In a competitive exam with 120 questions, there are three sections: General Knowledge (20 questions), Reasoning (50 questions), and English (50 questions). A candidate answered 70% of General Knowledge, 50% of Reasoning, and 30% of English questions correctly. If the minimum passing score is 60%, how many more questions did the candidate need to answer correctly to pass?
questions.questionHtml: In a competitive exam with 120 questions, there are three sections: General Knowledge (20 questions), Reasoning (50 questions), and English (50 questions). A candidate answered 70% of General Knowledge, 50% of Reasoning, and 30% of English questions correctly. If the minimum passing score is 60%, how many more questions did the candidate need to answer correctly to pass?
questions.solution:
• Correct answers section-wise:

• GK: 70% of 20 = 14

• Reasoning: 50% of 50 = 25

• English: 30% of 50 = 15

• Total correct = 14 + 25 + 15 = 54

• Passing marks = 60% of 120 = 72

• Additional questions needed = 72 - 54 = 18

• Answer: 18

questions.question: If the amount at the end of the 2nd year and 3rd year on a certain principal at compound interest is Rs.12,000 and Rs.13,200 respectively, find the rate of interest per annum.
questions.questionHtml: If the amount at the end of the 2nd year and 3rd year on a certain principal at compound interest is Rs.12,000 and Rs.13,200 respectively, find the rate of interest per annum.
questions.solution:
• Amount after 2nd year = Rs.12,000

• Amount after 3rd year = Rs.13,200

• Interest earned in 3rd year = 13,200 - 12,000 = Rs.1,200

• The 3rd year interest is calculated on the 2nd year amount (which acts as principal):

• Rate = (Interest / Principal) × 100 = (1,200 / 12,000) × 100 = 10% = 0.1

• Answer: 0.1
